content: खर {%a.%} (<ab>opp.</ab> मृदु, श्लक्ष्ण, द्रव) .²1 Hard, rough, solid. .²2 Severe, sharp, strict, <ls>R. 8. 9</ls>; स्मरः खरः खलः कान्तः <ls>Kāv. 1. 59</ls>. .²3 Pungent, acid. .²4 Dense, thick. .²5 Hurtful, injurious, cutting, smart (words). .²6 Sharpedged; देहि खरनयनशरघातम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. .²7 Hot; खरांशुः <ab>&c.</ab> .²8 Cruel; <ls>Rām. 6. 59. 17</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 An ass, <ls>Ms. 2. 201</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 115</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">120</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 370</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 160</ls>. .²2 A mule. .²3 A heron. .²4 A crow. .²5 A kind of prickly nightshade. .²6 A quadrangular mound of earth for receiving the sacrificial vessels. .²7 A Daitya or demon in general .²8 An attendant of .³({%a%}) Sūrya, .³({%b%}) Śiva. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, half-brother of Rāvaṇa and slain by Rāma; <ls>R. 12. 42</ls>. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of the 25th year of the sixty years cycle; खरो बालेयवर्षयोः <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-रम्@} {%ind.%} In a sharp way; <ls>Rām. 3</ls>.
